env._comment_support: Internal test builds only. The URL below is the real, live Payment Link — the project owner confirmed the Stripe account/payout setup and all four required reviews (legal, religious, iOS, Android) are complete (see docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md), so this build exercises the real donation flow end to end on a real device. None of these values are secrets (the URL is a public Stripe Payment Link). The production profile deliberately sets none of this inline — it is meant to be configured via EAS-hosted environment variables instead, so it can change without a new commit.

Set inline rather than via EAS-hosted environment variables (the earlier intent) because leaving them unset silently disabled the donation feature in every production build — getSupportConfig() reads undefined as false, so the Support entry vanished app-wide with no error. None of these are secrets: the URL is a public Stripe Payment Link, already committed in the preview profile above, and the flags are review-status gates, not credentials. The project owner has confirmed all four reviews (legal, religious, iOS, Android) — see docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md. Trade-off: changing the payment URL now needs a commit and a rebuild rather than a dashboard edit.
